items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Authorize no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 aggregate row is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage reports $886.12 across 4,865 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, but infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and defined learning-outcome records are incomplete. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, and budget exposure are therefore not calculable. Minimum measurement: period-aligned attributable revenue by tracking ID and site/content; reconciled AI-cost ledger; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and defined learning-outcome records. Treat impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, orders, shipped items, performance metrics, and AI usage as operating signals—not financial returns. Continue only existing attribution and cost reconciliation; retain all opportunities as deferred backlog.
